steps.body: The 120 chart is rows of ten. Each row has 10 numbers and ends in a 0: 10, 20, 30.
steps.narration: The 120 chart is rows of ten. Each row has ten numbers and ends in a zero: ten, twenty, thirty.

steps.body: Match each row's start to its end.

widget.prompt: Each row of ten runs from a start number to an end number. Match them.

pairErrors.feedback: The row from 11 counts up ten: 11 to 20, not 10.
The row from 21 ends at 30 — ten numbers: 21, 22, … 30.

widget.missFeedback: Each row has 10 numbers, so it ends 9 more than its start.

predict.prompt: Every row of ten ends on what kind of number?
predict.reveal: A row finishes where its ten completes — on the round tens number. The next row starts fresh right after it.

explanationVariants: The row starting at 21 holds 21–30, so it ends at 30.

widget.prompt: A row starts at 21. What number ends it?

commonErrors.feedback: 20 ends the row BEFORE this one. The row from 21 ends at 30.
31 starts the NEXT row. This row ends at 30.

steps.body: Read a row left to right, counting up by one. The next row starts the next ten.
steps.narration: Read a row left to right, counting up by one. The next row starts the next ten.

widget.prompt: Drag these into the order they appear across a row.

misorderFeedback.feedback: A row reads left to right, smallest first: 31, then up.

widget.missFeedback: Across a row, numbers go up by one: 31, 32, 33, 34, 35.

explanationVariants: Each row of the chart holds exactly 10 numbers.
A row is one ten — 10 numbers across.

widget.prompt: How many numbers are in each row of the chart?

commonErrors.feedback: Don't forget the number that ends in 0. A full row has 10.
A row stops at the ten. It holds exactly 10 numbers.

explanationVariants: Row-enders end in 0. 40 ends the row 31–40.
A number that ends a row is a ten: 40.

options.feedback: Yes — 40 ends the row 31–40. Row-enders end in 0.
45 sits in the middle of a row, not the end. Row-enders end in 0.
41 STARTS a row. Row-enders end in 0, like 40.

explanationVariants: The row 31–40 ends at 40, so the next row starts at 41.
One more than the row-ender 40 begins the next ten: 41.

widget.prompt: The row after 31–40 starts at what number?

commonErrors.feedback: 50 ENDS the next row. It starts at 41.
40 ends the row before. The next row starts at 41.

widget.fallbackFeedback: After 40 comes 41 — the start of the next row.

takeaways: The next row starts the next ten.
steps.teaser: next: find any number on the chart.

concept.body: Slow it down. A row is ten numbers in a line. It starts at a 1-number and ends at a 0-number: 51–60.
concept.narration: A row is ten numbers in a line. It starts at a one-number and ends at a zero-number: fifty-one to sixty.

explanationVariants: The row starting at 51 ends at 60.

widget.prompt: A row starts at 51. What number ends it?

commonErrors.feedback: 50 ends the row before. The row from 51 ends at 60.
61 starts the next row. This one ends at 60.
